name: playlists
description: An ordered, looping list of media items owned by a company or one branch, with its transition. Several programs may schedule the same playlist.
lifecycle: Created empty; renames, transition changes and item replacements bump the version. Deleted at runtime, with its items, only when no schedule rule or default uses it. The owning scope never changes. See docs/project/programming-design.md.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the playlist; immutable (tenant key).
Branch that owns the playlist; immutable.
columns.Null meaning: The playlist belongs to the whole company and every member who may view programming sees it.

columns.Meaning: Display name chosen by members, trimmed, 1 to 120 characters.
PostgreSQL-clock instant of the last change.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, branch_id) REFERENCES branches(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The owning branch belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A playlist belongs to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK ((((transition = 'CUT'::"PlaylistTransition") AND (fade_ms IS NULL)) OR ((transition = 'FADE'::"PlaylistTransition") AND ((fade_ms >= 250) AND (fade_ms <= 2000)))))
constraints.Purpose: A fade carries a duration from 250 to 2,000 ms and a cut carries none.
Names are trimmed and not empty.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX playlists_company_created_idx ON public.playlists USING btree (company_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
constraints.Purpose: Lists a company's playlists newest first with keyset cursors.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX playlists_company_id_id_key ON public.playlists USING btree (company_id, id)
